Select: assay_chembl_id, tid, assay_description, target_name, target_organism, journal, year, volume, first_page, doi. Source: assays, target_dictionary, docs. Join: assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid; assays.doc_id = docs.doc_id. Filter: assays.assay_type = 'B'; assays.tid = 165. Sort: assay_chembl_id ASC, tid ASC, journal ASC, year ASC, doi ASC.
